objective: Make the first four BUKLOD Community Walls paint visible photo state reliably and hydrate scoped multi-photo media without dropping late results
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 6cc7ac0f594c1a852c8b8b27bf2d70c018a73bf8; Android runtime 1.3.2 exact phone OTA adoption not verified; read-only Supabase audit: 814 indexed legacy previews, 209 conversion failures and 209/209 original objects retained. Legacy queue remains disabled.
chosenApproach: Early exact-scope feed paint with durable primary path, one independent late media RPC, metadata-only enrichment, request generation guarding, and small non-obscuring Android loading indicator until display confirmation.
selectionRationale: Avoid unnecessary backend work, duplicate media requests and further native paint regression; preserve existing original/preview stream and stable cache keys.
alternativeApproaches: Increase image decode timeouts or remove previews globally (rejected: longer stalls and weak-network bytes)
Restart failed background conversion or enable billable Storage transformations immediately (rejected: compute/cost and production integrity risk)
preserveBehaviors: Private signed media and RLS unchanged
Public Wall hydration, native sharp stream and existing cache unchanged
Only first four main Wall types; Marites/Profile/Connect unaffected
No OTA, APK, paid image transformations or backend mutation from DEV commit
acceptanceChecks: Scope posts paint as soon as core RPC returns
Late media RPC enriches multi-photo collage without duplicate request
Old async response never overwrites a new scope
Author/comments never erase already loaded photos
Android tiles visibly indicate load until painted
Focused Node tests, TypeScript and CI required before RC/Production
